stories.title: U.S. national arrested by NIA under terror charges gets bail after 180-day probe deadline lapses

en.title: U.S. national arrested by NIA under terror charges gets bail after 180-day probe deadline lapses
en.summary: A U.S. national arrested on terror charges received bail after India's National Investigation Agency failed to file complete charges within the 180-day deadline. The agency filed limited charges under immigration law rather than the more serious unlawful activities statute.
